# RealBroker

> An invite-only, broker-to-broker network for Bangalore's real estate professionals, enabling trusted collaboration and side-by-side deals on verified inventory.

## Pages

- [Home](/): What RealBroker is, the side-by-side partnership model, and the request-to-join form.
- [Members](/members): Directory of vetted broker members with their profiles and areas of expertise.
- [Tools](/tools): Preview of the dashboard and tools available to network members.
- [Certified RealBroker](/certified-realbroker): The certification programme for member brokers.
- [Smart Agreements](/smart-agreements): How co-broking agreements work inside the network.

## Optional

- [Charter](/charter): The network's charter.
- [Charter and Conduct](/charter-and-conduct): Code of conduct for members.
- [Terms of Use](/terms-of-use): Terms governing use of the site.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): How member and visitor data is handled.
